package.name: autokart_vcu_bridge
package.description: Sole USB/serial VCU endpoint owner: relays an already-authorized candidate motion command into the AutoKart laptop-VCU wire protocol and publishes ActuatorFeedback/VcuState from telemetry. Reuses autokart_vehicle_bridge.protocol/core. Standalone, portable node from the autokart_ros_nodes library.
